behavior.format: unchanged coordinated rank-zero v2 ZIP_STORED metadata.json plus every rank-N.pt; no DCP
behavior.validation: existing complete-member/hash/ACK validator and trusted publisher checks original inputs, fixed world, environment, group identity and every current fence
behavior.same_key_requires: identical entire verified metadata, full archive SHA-256/size, group and rank contributions
behavior.lookup: existing indexed current-job/attempt COMMITTED DDP rows, incrementally read; no JSON-SQL extension or sort
behavior.serialization: check after validation and again inside final SQLite write transaction before COMMITTED/head CAS
behavior.identical_retry: return verified canonical committed receipt; reject redundant transport intent; no head/revision/job-pointer/event change
behavior.independent_collectors: at most one COMMITTED manifest/head revision/event for one consistent SDK save
behavior.old_save_replay: canonical old acknowledgment only; latest is not rewound
behavior.new_save_same_step: allowed with a new checkpoint_id and existing monotonicity checks
behavior.fencing: current whole-group authority required before dedup; exact historical COMMITTED-ID read acknowledgments remain compatible
behavior.schema_api_flags: no schema/migration, public signature, route, transport, credential, world-size or default-flag changes
behavior.single_worker: bypasses DDP lookup; existing behavior retained
behavior.retention: redundant candidates and immutable orphan snapshots retained; never auto-adopted or deleted
